# Function index {#sec-functions}

For a workflow from the package vignette, use the [vignette guide](vignette-guide.qmd).

Choose the function name for its methodological entry, the chapter for its scientific context, or **Help** to open its individual 2.0.9004 help page. The index includes 69 exported functions and seven registered S3 methods. Aliases share their canonical help page. The registered subset method has a source note because it has no dedicated package help page.

## Related data and reference topics

The package also documents `constellations`, `star.names`, `malta_entrances` and `malta_horizons`. These are data topics. Package-level help is available at `?skyscapeR`.
